newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 12.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Tuesday:
- United Nations officials and aid workers returned to Zaire with food and medicine for refugees.
- U.S. and Russian soldiers stopped fighting between Muslims and Bosnian Serbs near the town of Koraj.
- Discount retailer Wal-Mart is changing pop culture as it censors music sold in its stores.

- A Vietnamese who became a symbol of the horror of war in a picture taken of her screaming naked after a napalm attack more than 20 years ago participated in a Veterans Day memorial service in New York.
